messages:
sara: quick follow-up from the proofframe RFC: ops hit a reconciliation mismatch during a cross-region ingress cutover. we need a concrete rollout plan for proofframe_v2.
maria: can you summarize the mismatch? what failed in recon exactly?
sara: short: repo's recon found some events with missing regionEpoch in v1 envelope. migration code assumed default=0 which caused attribution to pick wrong tenant shard. result: a handful of credits assigned to placeholder account.
igor: oh no. is this the same gap we saw in the staging backfill? iirc backfill shim skipped two event shapes.
sara: yes. staging backfill had a partial mapper but not full validation. production backfill surfaced edge cases: nested envelope + legacy-signature header.
maria: finance flagged a customer ticket. we should lock down mitigations before changing topology.
devops-bot: deploy bot: prod-recon-job v2 started at 2025-04-12T03:12Z on cluster-a.
sara: proposal: 3-step conservative rollout for proofframe_v2:
  1) ingress compatibility shim: accept v2 and v1, normalize to internal canonical envelope (no downstream format change). lightweight, low risk.
  2) enable schema validation & strict mode for 10% canary tenants. strict rejects malformed v1 that lack regionEpoch/signature and surfaces to backfill queue.
  3) once canary is stable (48h), flip default to emit v2 from runtime and schedule a backfill window for last 90 days.
igor: what about reconciliation semantics? v2 adds claimKey and originEpoch fields which change dedupe logic. we must ensure recon uses claimKey precedence.
sara: agree. reconciler will prefer claimKey if present; otherwise fall back to event-hash. backfill will rewrite claimKey for older events where we can compute it deterministically.
maria: timeline? also need a rollback plan. finance wants maximum correction transparency.
sara: timeline: shim + validation in 2 days, canary for 1 week, backfill in week 3. rollback is switching ingress to passthrough mode and pausing runtime emission. all changes behind per-tenant flags.
igor: tests: add property tests for proofframe roundtrip + cross-region replay. also add integration with ledger finalizer to assert idempotency when claimKey collides.
sara: good call. I'll add those to the RFC as required CI gates.
devops-bot: canary infra: created feature-flag group proofframe_v2_canary (10% of tenants).
ci-bot: running integration:ingest/proofframe-compat (with region-fuzz)  started
ci-bot: integration results: 4/5 baseline variants passed; variant 3 failed due to time-skew deserialization. logs: https://ci.internal/runs/4639990000
igor: that time-skew failure is the same class as the earlier ledger race. we need to include clock-tolerance in parser (accept +/- 5s) and ensure reconciliation tolerates small epoch jumps.
maria: surface to ops: create alert for recon delta > $10 over 1h. finance wants notification and audit export.
audit-bot: note - if backfill rewrites proofframe metadata, audits-team must approve the proofframe migration mapping. tag: @audits-team.
sara: ok. action items: 
- sara: open RFC PR with shim code, tests, perf baseline (today)
- igor: add reconciler claimKey precedence & property tests (48h)
- devops: enable canary flag and alerting hook (tomorrow)
- ci-bot: re-run region-fuzz after parser tolerances updated (ig or sara to trigger)
- audits-team: review backfill mapping once RFC posted
maria: + please include a customer-visible changelog entry explaining "temporary attribution adjustments may appear, but will be corrected by backfill" and the rollback contact.
sara: will draft. ping when RFC is up. :+1:
